subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands use explicit per-account nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or remain unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, and the closed implementation attempts show a real design fork that expands Slack account config and native command routing behavior.

options.title: Implement validated nativeNames mapping
options.body: Add an explicit per-account map from internal command keys to Slack native names with strict Slack-name validation, duplicate checks, registration, reverse lookup, docs, and tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar for all native command names with strict lowercase slug validation, accepting a simpler operator setup but a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document duplicate names as unsupported
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement validated nativeNames mapping
recommendation.body: Add an explicit per-account map from internal command keys to Slack native names with strict Slack-name validation, duplicate checks, registration, reverse lookup, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest recent history on Slack native command aliases, the shared command registry, and the current ClawSweeper decision comment.
